title: Rainbow Ridge

services.name: NEW* RV Rentals
services.desc: The Ridge is a fully featured adult 2SLGBTIQA+ resort and campground located just over an hour drive from downtown Toronto. We welcome individuals of all gender identities to Rainbow Ridge and pride ourselves for our diversity. The resort grounds and amenities are immaculate and welcoming. Explore our website to see for yourself why we stand out from other 2SLGBTIQA+ resorts and campgrounds in Ontario. Inside you’ll find two bedrooms (queen and double), a large kitchen, 3-piece bathroom, storage room and an attached 20′ x 10′ garden-view room with fireplace, dining area and pull-out futon.
